surfaces.description: Filter and explore 35,000+ anime and manga titles from MyAnimeList with advanced search, statistics, schedules, and watchlists.
Filter anime by score, year, genres, themes, demographics, popularity, status, and format with shareable search URLs.
Pick a random anime from the public Shelf catalog and narrow the choice with the same discovery filters used by search.
Explore anime score distributions, formats, years, genres, themes, demographics, popularity, and catalog coverage.
Search and filter more than 20,000 manga titles by score, year, genres, themes, demographics, status, and format.
Explore manga score distributions, formats, years, genres, themes, demographics, popularity, and catalog coverage.
Answer four lightweight questions to get a Shelf viewing archetype and a prefilled public anime search.
Verified product releases for Shelf, including anime and manga discovery, watchlists, schedules, and catalog improvements.
Review daily anime and manga catalog ingestion history, update timing, and the latest public dataset refreshes.
Learn how Shelf combines MyAnimeList catalog data, advanced filtering, smart ranking, statistics, and personal tracking.
Understand Shelf account data, Google sign-in, watchlist storage, product analytics, and public collection visibility.
Terms for using Shelf catalog discovery, personal watchlists, public collections, and MyAnimeList-derived metadata.
Connect agents to Shelf public catalog tools and manage a personal access token for authenticated watchlist tools.
